requirements.requirement: Every table row on the site must carry a source link to an official site
requirements.how: verify.py checks every metrics/risks/questions/decisions/irregularities row has a non-empty source resolving to an allow-listed official domain, or is explicitly blank+flagged with a note explaining why no source exists

requirements.requirement: Values that cannot be confirmed from an official source must be left blank and flagged; never inferred
requirements.how: metrics.json blank rows publish value=""; verify.py fails if any blank row lacks a flag reference, and fails if any non-blank row is marked blank

requirements.requirement: No hallucinations; verify line by line
requirements.how: Every metric carries a source id; a scripted URL check fetches each unique source URL and records HTTP status in the verification log

requirements.requirement: Official/trusted sources only (government, regulator, court, SEC filings)
requirements.how: sources.json tiers; allow-list in verify.py limits publishers to gov/regulator/court/SEC domains (plus LAEDC clearly marked tier C)

requirements.requirement: Personal information must never appear on the site
requirements.how: No personal names, contacts or PII fields exist in the data layer; M153 records the deliberate decision not to collect owner identity; verify.py scans output HTML for PII patterns

requirements.requirement: Flagged or unverified items must be published on a Flagged for Review page, not hidden
requirements.how: flagged.html renders every blank metric and every irregularity with its flag id

requirements.requirement: Full risk register covering BAU and black-swan decisions using verified official sources
requirements.how: risks.json: 28 rows, each typed BAU or BLACK-SWAN with a source id or an explicit qualitative note

requirements.requirement: Analysis must balance wealth preservation, growth and manageable risk
requirements.how: decisions.json carries three strategies with explicit objectives and model outputs on a normalized index basis

requirements.requirement: Reliable projection system built from deep research
requirements.how: model.py implements deterministic index-basis scenarios plus a seeded Monte Carlo (seed 20261111); model.py --selftest validates arithmetic identities

requirements.requirement: Questions/information that must be resolved before any decision, with suggestions to discover missing info
requirements.how: questions.json: 22 open items each with why_it_matters, how_to_discover, owner

requirements.requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions: claim first, non-overlapping scope, small frequent commits, rebase before push
requirements.how: COORDINATION.md claim for session-2b3370d1 (label N); all files under session-2b3370d1/**; shared files changed only additively at final integration

requirements.requirement: Build a GitHub Pages live site: clean dashboard landing plus category subpages, tables for all findings
requirements.how: build_site.py generates 13 HTML pages in session-2b3370d1/; root index gains one additive workspace row; CI step added in .github/workflows/verify.yml

requirements.requirement: Merge own PR without waiting for approval; record PR link and merge in COORDINATION.md; confirm Pages deploys
requirements.how: Final integration steps in the session log

requirements.requirement: Never merge a broken site; fix and retry any build/check/deploy failure
requirements.how: CI gate: regenerate everything and require a clean git status; local tools/check_site.py must pass before merge
